failed replacement loads the previous animated GLB

findings: Continuous knee loops replace collar-like transitions on upright animals.
Stegosaur plates are broad flattened structures; Kentrosaurus has posterior spikes.
Sauropods use tapered curved necks; wolves and horses have separate proportions.
Pterosaurs have pointed beaks and membrane wings; marine reptiles have four solid paddles.
Small feathered theropods have separate forearm vanes; Microraptor also has hindwing feathers.
The selected Spinosaurus interpretation has shorter hindlimbs and a deepened tail.
limitations: Procedural game topology remains; these are not hand-sculpted or hand-retopologized film assets.
Fine facial/skin detail and foot-contact animation can benefit from further artist polish.
The automated checks verify exports and rendered integration, not commercial artistic quality.
No hardware FPS target or portable EXE rebuild is claimed.
